{{Quote|This is a secure area. You must have proper clearance. Stop at once!|An RA-7 protocol droid at a checkpoint by Coronet SFS-13|<ref name="SoloOG">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Coronet SFS-13''' was the designation of a [[factory]] operated in [[Coronet City]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] by [[Santhe Corporation]] and [[Sienar Fleet Systems]]. It was located on a pill by the [[city]]'s [[Antonian Lagoon]] and was used to manufactuer [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s. A memorial [[Fire|flame]] burned beside the factory commemorating those who [[Death|died]] [[Battle of the Corellian Shipyards|defending]] Coronet City's shipyards from the [[Nihil]] in [[230 BBY]].

In [[13 BBY]], the [[scrumrat]]s [[Han Solo|Han]] and [[Qi'ra]] raced past the front of the factory in a [[M-68 landspeeder]] while fleeing from the criminal [[White Worms]] gang, breaking through the barrier at an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] checkpoint as they did so. A [[A-A4B truckspeeder]] belonging to the White Worms then passed the factory while pursuing the pair.

==Description==
The factory designated Coronet SFS-13 was located on a pill by the [[Antonian Lagoon]] in [[Coronet City]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. It consisted of a long and narrow [[Color|gray]] building with sloped, curved sides and a roof of varying heights, some of which was marked with red lighting. The slopes gave way to vertically flat walls on one corner of the building which was lined with multiple floors of windows. Brown piping emerged from the building at various points of differing height before descending into the ground around it, with a pair of gray pipes also descending from roof to ground. Two waste heat exchangers towered over the factory on one side and a cylindrical silo stood near them, with all three bearing the same red lights as the factory's roof.<ref name="CLNE" />

Coronet SFS-13 covered the entrity of the pill it was located on, which joined with the pill housing the [[Coronet City Spaceport]] at one corner. The factory's pill was also connected by bridge to a pill where<ref name="CLNE" /> another Santhe/Sienar factory designated [[Coronet-SFS-14]]<ref name="SoloOG" /> was located, as well as a [[Kuat Drive Yards]] factory designated [[Coronet-KDY-14]], the [[shipyard central office]], the [[Otlair fish market]], and the [[Maritime operations center and CorSec coast guards station]]. The road on the road on the bridge continued round one side of Coronet SFS-13 and then became the [[Shug Drabor Causeway]] over the [[Water|lagoon]], which was a branch of [[Narro Sienar Boulevard]].<ref name="CLNE" />

==History==
{{Quote|You must follow the proper… Protocol.|The RA-7 protocol droid is struck by a truck speeder outside the factory|<ref name="Solo" />}}
During the [[Imperial Era]], a memorial [[Fire|flame]] burned beside Coronet SFS-13 to commemorate those who felld defending Coronet's shipyards from the [[Nihil]],<ref name="CLNE" /> a group of [[pirate]]s who unsuccessfully [[Battle of the Corellian Shipyards|attacked]] the shipyards when they were under the protection of the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order]] in [[230 BBY]] during the [[High Republic Era]].<ref name="Timelinse">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref>

[[File:CoronetSFS-13-Solo.png|thumb|right|300px|Han and Qi'ra raced past Coronet SFS-13 in a landspeeder.]]
In [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events depicted on the [[Corellia]] page of ''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' to [[13 BBY]].</ref> Coronet SFS-13 was operated by [[Santhe Corporation]] and [[Sienar Fleet Systems]]. It acted as an assembly plant for [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s used by the [[Galactic Empire]]<ref name="CLNE" /> and was treated as a secure area with an Imperial-staffed gated checkpoint on the bridge leading to the neighbouring pill.<ref name="Solo" /> In that [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[scrumrat]]s [[Han Solo|Han]] and [[Qi'ra]] fled from the criminal [[White Worms]] gang in a [[M-68 landspeeder]] and were forced to divert down the Shug Dabor Causeway on their way to the [[spaceport]].<ref name="Solo" />

The pair raced past the factory once on its pill and then drove straight through the closed bridge gate, drawing cries of protest from a [[Unidentified RA-7 protocol droid (Coronet City)|RA-7 protocol droid]] at the checkpoint. The [[RA-7 protocol droid|droid]] was then smashed to pieces when a [[A-A4B truckspeeder]] driven by members of the White Worms raced passed Coronet SFS-13 and collided with the droid, continuing over the bridge in pursuit of the landspeeder.<ref name="Solo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coronet SFS-13 first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> It was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'',<ref name="CLNE" /> the new material for which was written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Emily Shkoukani]].<ref name="Bluesky">{{Bluesky|jasoncfry.bsky.social|post/3ljusdhg5mc26|[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-03-08|quote=Just got a copy of the newly revised Star Wars: Complete Locations from DK, out Tuesday!
